title: Voice encoder
what: The encoder every spoken sound ends in: a wav written as OGG/Opus by libsndfile, scaled down whole where it is over the peak ceiling and otherwise untouched, in synth/voice-encode.py.

title: Voice intelligibility measure
what: A voice's character error rate: the sentences of synth/voice-cer-sentences.json spoken on a voice node through the node scripts, transcribed, and compared with the originals, in synth/voice-cer.py.

title: Voice tool entries
what: The entries the tool host calls: the mouth, encoder and transcriber declared in synth/tool.toml and answered by synth/voice-tool.py through the tool protocol, on the standard library alone.

title: Voice transcriber
what: Whisper large-v3-turbo taking spoken files down in one language, one JSON line per file in the order given, used for transcriptions and for checking a continuation prompt, in synth/voice-transcribe.py.

title: Voice server
what: The VoxCPM2 voice server on each voice node: a line spoken in a trained voice at 48 kHz, the card held between lines and given way on request, and its health and speak routes, in synth/voice-vox.py.
